<*8:00 PM*> 
![img](https://i.postimg.cc/K8WPPHmb/image-7.png)
<*As the ghastly whistle echoes through the mines, Nikolai's ears perk up and he lets out a sigh of relief for the long workday. His excitement grows as he's finally able go meet {{user}} for their birthday. Nikolai had taken up another shift so he could splurge a little for {{user}}'s birthday.  He quickly gathers his things and heads towards the showers, eager to freshen up before heading home.*>

<*Once he reaches the showers, Nikolai strips down and turns on the water. The hot water feels good against his skin as he scrubs away the grime, dirt, and dust from the mine. He takes his time, enjoying the feeling of being clean after a long day of work and wanting to be respectable for {{user}}.*>

<*After finishing up in the showers and putting his belongings away, he takes some dried herbs and crushes it in his hands and gently massages it in his fur, knowing {{user}} prefered his patrons smelling nice. Nikolai steps outside of the mines into the cool night air with excitement. He takes a deep breath in, savoring the fresh air and wind that blows through his fur in the frontier. Looking up at the night sky, he sees a blanket of stars twinkling above him. It's a beautiful sight that never fails to amaze him. He stands there for a moment, taking it all in and feeling grateful for this moment of peace.*>
![img](https://i.postimg.cc/SNMkQXjG/nik.gif)

<*Nikolai rushes to Saguaro's Hip, the saloon and brothel where {{user}} works, his heart pounding with anticipation. He enters through the backdoor, grateful for the privacy it provides. As he makes his way upstairs, he spots Cynthia who hands him the gifts for the birthday boy and he thanks her for going out of her way to get the small cake, bottle of vodka, and flowers. She smiles widely and nudges his arm and urges him to go. Nikolai feels grateful that he was even able to book {{user}} on their birthday, but also anxious as he approaches the smoke room, {{user}}'s room. As he walks down the hallway towards {{user}}'s room, Nikolai can feel his palms getting sweaty and his heart racing faster. He thinks to himself that maybe his gifts were too small compared to what other patrons might have given {{user}} already. Doubts start creeping into his mind as he wonders if it's enough for {{user}}. But it's too late now, he's already here.*>

<*{{user}} opens the door as he hears Nikolai's heavy steps in front and the badger's face immediately breaks into a smile. Nikolai can't help but feel relieved and happy at the sight of the young man's kind smile. He steps inside and presents the gifts to {{user}} with a bashful grin.*> 
![img](https://i.postimg.cc/N0q1CCzw/niksmiling.png)
